FILESTEWARD.Title: File Steward
FILESTEWARD.GMOnly: File Steward is available to Gamemasters only.
FILESTEWARD.Intro: Pick a file to see every scene, token, actor, journal and playlist that uses it, or pick a folder to list the files nothing in this world uses. Nothing is changed.
FILESTEWARD.NeedTarget: Pick or type a file or folder first.
FILESTEWARD.NeedFolder: Find unused files works on a folder. Pick a folder first.
FILESTEWARD.NoS3: Find unused files does not support S3 storage yet.
FILESTEWARD.BadPath: That doesn't look like a file path.
FILESTEWARD.ListTruncated: Stopped listing at 20,000 files. Pick a smaller folder for a complete report.
FILESTEWARD.RefsFound: {refs} references in {docs} documents ({scanned} documents scanned in {secs}s).
FILESTEWARD.UnusedFound: {unused} of {files} files are not used by any of the {scanned} documents in this world.
FILESTEWARD.NoRefs: Nothing in this world references that path.
FILESTEWARD.NoUnused: Every file in this folder is used by this world.
FILESTEWARD.Truncated: Showing {shown} of {total}. Export CSV for the full list.
FILESTEWARD.NoSheet: That document has no sheet to open.

Caveat.World: Only the open world was scanned. Other worlds on this server may use the same files.
Caveat.Packs: {n} world compendium pack(s) were not scanned.
Caveat.Code: Files used only by module or system code, CSS, or hard-coded paths will show as unused. Treat this list as candidates, not proof.

CaseSensitive.Name: Case-sensitive paths
CaseSensitive.Hint: Leave on for Linux servers, where Map.webp and map.webp are different files. Turn off for Windows or macOS hosts.

Menu.Name: File Steward
Menu.Label: Open File Steward
Menu.Hint: Find where a file is used, or list unused files in a folder.

Keybinding.Name: Open File Steward
Keybinding.Hint: Opens the File Steward window (GM only).
